notes: Authoritative source: official Colorlight X20 Specification V2.0 PDF (Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd., published on colorlightinside.com, mirrored via ledincloud.com). Overview text says "DP1.4" but the detailed rear-panel table and Signal Format table both confirm DP1.2 — DP1.2 is treated as authoritative (likely a typo in the marketing overview line). RS232 is via a 6P6C RJ11 jack (with DB9-to-RJ11 adapter cable supplied) — closest list match is rs232 connector type but physical jack is RJ11, noted here since no RJ11 id exists in the allowed list. The two 10G "FIBER" ports use dual-LC connectors with a 10G single-mode optical SFP module purchased separately (single-mode, 1310nm, 2km) — mapped to fiber-lc; Ethernet output and optical output are mutually exclusive per port group (FIBER 1 mirrors PORT 1-10, FIBER 2 mirrors PORT 11-20). A rear-panel 3.5mm-style 3D sync output jack (optional accessory) exists but has no matching connector id in the allowed list, so it is omitted. Power rated at only 50W via a standard fused AC inlet (100-240V, 50/60Hz) consistent with IEC C13/C14; connector photo on spec sheet shows a standard IEC inlet with an integrated fuse holder. Unit is a 2U rack-mount chassis (482.6mm W x 88.0mm H x 414.1mm D).

ports.name: HDMI 2.0
ports.note: Backward compatible with HDMI 1.4/1.3; max 4096x2160@60Hz; supports audio input and EDID settings

ports.name: DP 1.2
ports.note: Max 4096x2160@60Hz; supports audio input and EDID settings

ports.name: HDMI 1
ports.note: Max 1920x1200@60Hz; supports audio input and EDID settings

ports.name: HDMI 2
ports.note: Max 1920x1200@60Hz; supports audio input and EDID settings

ports.name: PORT 1-20 (Ethernet Output)
ports.note: 20x 1000BASE-T ports; ~650,000 pixels load capacity per port; recommended max Cat5e run 100m; mutually exclusive with FIBER outputs; represents 20 physical RJ45 jacks

ports.name: FIBER 1
ports.note: Dual-LC 10G optical output corresponding to PORT 1-10; requires separately purchased 10G single-mode SFP module (1310nm, 2km); mutually exclusive with Ethernet output on same group

ports.name: FIBER 2
ports.note: Dual-LC 10G optical output corresponding to PORT 11-20; requires separately purchased 10G single-mode SFP module (1310nm, 2km); mutually exclusive with Ethernet output on same group

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Control port, connects to network switch for TCP/IP control

ports.name: RS232
ports.note: Physical jack is RJ11 (6P6C), not DB9; ships with DB9-female-to-RJ11 adapter cable for central control integration

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-B, connects to PC for debugging/control

ports.name: USB OUT
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A, used for cascading to additional units

ports.name: AUDIO IN
ports.note: Receives audio signal from computers/other equipment

ports.name: AUDIO OUT
ports.note: Outputs decoded HDMI/DP audio to active speakers or similar devices

ports.name: AC Power Socket
ports.note: AC100-240V~ 50/60Hz, rated 50W, built-in fuse; standard fused IEC inlet
